translation: Clouding and loss of consciousness (昏憒) in injury is the most severe of injuries, so that one becomes clouded and loses consciousness of human affairs; one should urgently pour Single Ginseng Decoction (獨參湯) into the mouth. Even if there is stagnant blood within, one must by no means purge; urgently use Flower Stone Powder (花蕊石散) to transform it internally. This is because one fears that purging, by causing diarrhea, will cause loss of yin. If the original qi is extremely deficient, one especially must not purge, and also use the aforementioned powder to transform it.
